text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 26px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue'; text-anchor: middle

g.text: Reference-emotion adjustment and equal class weights; values are percentage points per doubling.
Blue: lower accuracy on longer clips. Orange: higher accuracy. n/a: unavailable or unidentifiable.
Each cell uses its own dataset; this does not compare longer and shorter datasets.
Cells are point estimates, not significance tests. Gemma 4 is available on MELD only.
Slopes are local: narrow duration ranges can yield large slopes. Do not extrapolate.
